name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Hanging Pieces Ornament With Crystal Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material: 
    -  Made from high-quality 3mm wood, lightweight, durable, and finely cut for a smooth and elegant finish.
    -  Includes a sparkling crystal charm that reflects light beautifully, adding a luxurious and eye-catching touch.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions: 
    -  Wooden Ornament Size: 5 × 5 inches ~ 12.7 × 12.7 cm
    -  Total Hanging Length (Including Chain): 22 cm ~ 8.66 in
    -  Crystal Charm Size: Diameter: 3 cm (1.18 in) - Height: 4 cm (1.57 in)
    -  Thickness of wooden frame: 3mm
    -  Two Display Styles Available:
    ✨ Style 1: Crystal Inside + Hanging Wooden Piece (1 Tier)
    •   The crystal charm hangs inside the main wooden frame, creating a floating and elegant look.
    •   A single wooden tier piece (heart, tag, circle, etc.) hangs below the ornament, printed on both sides.
    ✨ Style 2: Crystal Hanging Below + Inner Wooden Pieces (1 Tier)
    •   The crystal charm hangs below the main wooden frame, allowing it to catch more sunlight and cast stronger rainbows.
    •   Inside the main frame, there are small wooden pieces (1 tier)—often used for photos, names, dates, or decorative elements.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed. Sizes may vary slightly depending on the chosen custom shape.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    -  Printed using UV printing technology, ensuring sharp, vibrant, and fade-resistant images.
    -  The product supports double-sided printing, allowing your photo or artwork to be beautifully displayed on both sides.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    This ornament is perfect for hanging on windows, walls, car mirrors, Christmas trees, or any space where you want to add a personal and sparkling touch. The crystal prism creates beautiful light reflections when hit by sunlight, making it both decorative and meaningful.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion: 
    A thoughtful, customizable keepsake suitable for all ages and every special event—including Christmas, Valentine’s Day, anniversaries, birthdays, weddings, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, housewarming, or simply as a heartfelt everyday gift.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Hanging Pieces Ornament With Crystal Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
